description: This file defines the TeamDemoData class, which provides methods for creating, managing, and assigning demo data to team objects in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for generating demo data, assigning users to teams, and retrieving random teams or team sets.

classes.name: TeamDemoData
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and managing demo data associated with teams within the CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TeamDemoData object with a team object and a flag for large-scale testing.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Creates demo team data based on the existing data set and optionally generates additional teams for large-scale testing.

methods.name: add_users_to_team
methods.description: Assigns specific users to predefined teams ('West' and 'East').

methods.name: get_random_team
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected team name from the seed data.

methods.name: get_random_teamset
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected team set (array of team names).

methods.name: _seed_data_get_team_list
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined team names used for demo data.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_teamset_list
methods.description: Provides predefined sets of team names for demo purposes.

methods.name: _quick_create
methods.description: Creates a team with a given name if it does not already exist.
